final_user_requirement: Keep surveillance and calculations in the backend. The existing frontend shows route results, ETA, distance and congestion estimates without camera panels or calculation explanations.
flow: Existing route form -> actual FastAPI route handler -> fresh CCTV exact-edge cost when eligible -> existing route result and journey map
authentication_scope: Isolated loopback test process replaces operator identity only. Real account/session untouched.
limitations: Camera image congestion remains provisional and does not establish physical speed or measured travel time.
Historical camera-panel screenshots document earlier engineering verification and do not describe the final frontend.

hidden_backend_camera_audit.limitations: Image congestion is an estimate over the camera's mapped view. The penalty expresses a routing preference, not measured delay; unobserved roads retain the existing planning model.
hidden_backend_camera_audit.maximum_penalty: 2 times existing edge free-flow seconds before objective weighting
